Welcome to our E-Shop and Social Platform (the "App"). By downloading, accessing, or using the App, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service ("Terms"). If you do not agree to these Terms, do not use the App.

Our App allows you to sign in using your Google (Gmail) Account. Data Security: We handle your authentication securely through official Google OAuth protocols. We do not store or have access to your Google password. Accuracy: You agree to maintain the security of your account and take responsibility for all activities that occur under your profile.

Because our App contains a social feed, status updates, and interactive chat/call sections, you are solely responsible for the content you upload, post, or transmit (collectively, "UGC"). CRITICAL GOOGLE PLAY COMPLIANCE: We enforce a strict zero-tolerance policy for objectionable content and abusive behavior. You explicitly agree NOT to post, share, or transmit any content that: Is defamatory, libelous, obscene, pornographic, vulgar, or offensive. Promotes discrimination, bigotry, racism, hatred, harassment, or harm against any individual or group. Is violent, threatening, or promotes violence or actions that are threatening to any person or animal. Promotes illegal activities, substances, or transactions. Infringes upon any third-party intellectual property, privacy, or publicity rights.

To maintain a safe community ecosystem, we provide the following built-in safety features: Reporting Mechanisms: The App provides clear, easily accessible tools next to user posts, profiles, and within chats allowing any user to flag/report objectionable UGC or abusive behavior. Blocking Capabilities: Users can block any other user instantly within the App to prevent further communication, chat, calls, or visibility of feed updates. Our Right to Moderate: We reserve the right (but are not obligated) to review, pre-screen, refuse, filter, or delete any UGC at our sole discretion. Penalties for Violations: Any user found in violation of these Terms or Google Play Program Policies will face immediate consequences, including but not limited to content removal, temporary account suspension, or permanent termination of access to the App without warning.

Respectful Interaction: The real-time chat and calling features are provided to enhance your shopping and social experience. You may not use these features to spam, stalk, or harass other users. Privacy in Communication: While one-on-one chats are private between users, using these features to distribute malware, scams, phishing links, or fraudulent e-shop transactions is strictly prohibited and will result in permanent account bans.

Transactions: The App acts as a marketplace/platform for purchasing goods. All purchases are subject to billing, shipping, and return policies explicitly posted within the E-Shop dashboard. Prohibited Items: Users and vendors may not list, trade, or buy items that violate local laws or Google Play's restricted content guidelines (e.g., regulated goods, weapons, tobacco).

We reserve the right to terminate or suspend your account and access to the App at our sole discretion, without notice, for conduct that we believe violates these Terms, Google Play Policies, or is harmful to other users, us, or third parties.

We may modify these Terms at any time. If we make material changes, we will notify you through an in-app alert or via your registered Google email. Continued use of the App after updates means you accept the revised Terms.

How do I change my profile picture?
Go to your profile page and tap \'Edit Profile\'. From there, you can tap on your current profile picture to upload a new one.
How do I report an inappropriate post or user?
Tap the three dots on the top right of any post and select \'Report\'. To block a user, visit their profile, tap the menu, and choose \'Block\'.
Can I use the app offline?
Yes! EyeField securely caches posts and media on your device, allowing you to browse loaded feeds and products even without an active internet connection.
How do I delete my account?
Navigate to Settings > Account Management > Danger Zone, where you will find the option to permanently delete your account and all associated data.

We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the personal data you share with us. This Privacy Policy explains how our App collects, uses, discloses, and safeguards your information when you use our mobile application, including our e-shop, social feeds, chats, calling features, and audio/music integration tools.

1. Information We Collect
We collect data to provide a functional, secure, and legally compliant e-commerce and social experience.

A. Data You Provide to Us Automatically via Third-Party Authentication
â€¢ Google Account Data: When you sign in using Google OAuth, we collect your name, email address, profile picture, and Google User ID for authentication and account security.

B. User-Generated Content, Audio, & Copyrighted Music
â€¢ Social Feed, Status Updates, & Audio Integration: We collect and store the text, photos, videos, and audio files (including music tracks, voiceovers, and sound clips) that you explicitly attach to your public status or social feed.
â€¢ Licensed Audio & Metadata: If you utilize our in-app licensed music library to add copyrighted music to your posts, we collect transaction and usage metadata (e.g., track ID, artist name, and duration used) to fulfill our reporting obligations to our music licensing partners.
â€¢ Chats & Message History: Your text chats, images, and audio/video media sent within the user-to-user chat system are transmitted and stored securely on our servers to ensure reliable delivery.
â€¢ Real-Time Calls: We process call metadata (such as duration and participant IDs) to establish voice/video connections. We do not record or store the real-time audio/video content of your calls.

C. Commercial & Transactional Data
â€¢ Purchase History: We collect data regarding the items you view or purchase within the e-shop section to fulfill orders.
â€¢ Payment Information: Payment processing is handled securely by certified third-party payment gateways; we do not store raw financial credentials on our servers.

2. Permissions Required
To provide the social and media features of the App, we request access to certain device features:
â€¢ Camera: Required for profile updates, feed photos, or video calls.
â€¢ Microphone & Audio Capture: Required to record audio for status updates, capture sound for custom user videos, or engage in voice/video calls.
â€¢ Storage / Photos & Media: Required to upload items to the e-shop, share media in chats, or import audio/video files from your device.

3. Intellectual Property, Copyright, and Licensing Content
We respect the intellectual property rights of artists, musicians, and creators.
â€¢ Authorized Use Only: Users are strictly prohibited from uploading audio tracks or video content containing copyrighted music unless they own the rights or have an explicit license to distribute that audio on our platform.
â€¢ Licensing Partner Data Sharing: To legally clear copyright permissions for music played within the App, we may share anonymized, aggregated playback data (track plays, duration) with performance rights organizations (PROs) and music labels. No personal data or identity metrics are shared during this licensing audit process.

4. How We Use Your Information
We use the collected information for the following specific purposes:
â€¢ To authenticate your identity and maintain your active user account.
â€¢ To manage e-shop transactions, orders, and deliveries.
â€¢ To process, format, and display social feed content containing video and audio tracks.
â€¢ To enforce platform safety, monitor for objectionable User-Generated Content (UGC), and process copyright takedown notices.

5. Data Sharing and Third Parties
We do not sell your personal data. We only share information with:
â€¢ Service Providers: Trusted cloud, infrastructure, and database providers.
â€¢ Payment Gateways: Secure third-party payment processors.
â€¢ Copyright Enforcement/Legal: If a formal copyright infringement claim (such as a DMCA notice) is filed against your user-generated content, we may be legally required to communicate with the copyright owner or legal authorities regarding the offending material.

6. Data Retention and Security
We retain your personal data and social media/audio uploads only as long as your account remains active. We implement industry-standard encryption protocols (SSL/TLS) to secure data in transit and at rest.

7. Data Deletion and Your Rights (Google Play Compliance)
We fully support your right to control your personal data and uploaded media.
â€¢ Account Deletion: You can delete your account and all associated personal information (including your social posts, text chats, and uploaded audio/video files) at any time directly through the Settings menu inside the App.
â€¢ Web-Based Deletion Requests: In compliance with Google Play Developer Policies, if you cannot access the App, you can request full account and data deletion by visiting our dedicated deletion portal at eyefield.pro/delete-account or by contacting our support team via email at support@eyefield.pro.

8. Changes to This Policy
We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by updating the "Last Updated" date at the top of this page.
If you have any questions or wish to report an issue, please contact us.
Or email us directly at: support@eyefield.pro
